outline:
Scope: This course is to introduce useful data mining techniques for students. We hope that students can learn more fundamental and advanced skills in the competitive mobile commerce world.
“Necessity is the mother of invention”—Data mining—Automated analysis of massive data sets.
Data mining (knowledge discovery from data) : Extraction of interesting (non-trivial, implicit, previously unknown and potentially useful) patterns or knowledge from huge amount of data.
schedule:
1: Introduction
2~3: Data preprocessing
4~5: Mining association rules in large databases
6: Project report 1
7~8: Classification and prediction
9: Project report 2
10~11: Cluster analysis
12: Mining complex types of data
13: Project report 3
14~15: Spatial and temporal data mining
16~17: Advanced topics in data mining
18: Final project report
scorePolicy:
1. Project report 15% x 3 = 45%
2. Final project report 25%
3. Other performance + HWs 30%
materials:
Textbook: J. Han and M. Kamber, Data Mining: Concepts and Techniques, Morgan Kaufmann Publishers
Reference: M.H. Dunham, Data mining: introductory and advanced topics, 歐亞書局代理
